Place plants on the battlefield, merge identical units to create stronger versions, and build the perfect defense for every level. Different zombies have unique abilities, so you will need to choose your plants carefully and adjust your strategy as the battle becomes more difficult. instructions: Mouse click or tap to play

title: Go Octopus Find Pearl
description: Go Octopus Find Pearl is an underwater adventure puzzle game where you control a cute octopus exploring the deep sea to find precious gems. Overcome obstacles, avoid dangerous creatures, and choose the right path to collect all the gems in each level. The gameplay is simple yet addictive, with lively graphics and many exciting challenges, suitable for all ages.
instructions: WASD or Arrows Button to move

title: Super Hero Survivor Io
description: Step into an explosive battlefield where chaos never stops in Super Hero Survivor Io! This fast-paced survival adventure throws you into endless waves of enemies across mysterious zones, blending intense combat, upgrades, and hero evolution into one thrilling experience. If you love fast reflex gameplay with constant action, this title delivers the ultimate Zombie survival IO excitement.
instructions: Click and drag Play
